description: Close in hard on the hero of the shot so it fills most of the frame, everything behind it soft and near.
Tight from a hand's breadth away, the nearest surfaces and the bees on them crisply detailed.
Close and slightly above, looking down across the open box from just past one of its edges, the surfaces running away at a shallow angle.
Close on the hero from one side so it sits large in the near third of the frame, its own surroundings close behind it.
Close at chest height, the hero filling the middle of the frame and the nearest hive soft just beyond it.
Close and square on, the hero flat to the camera and large, everything around it falling off gently into softness.
Close and angled slightly upward into the branch overhead, leaves closing the top of the frame.
Close down onto the bench top from just above it, the near edge of the bench crossing the bottom of the frame.
Medium framing at standing height, the hero and the hive beside it filling the lower half of the frame.
Medium framing from one side, close enough that the hero and the box beside it both read large.
Medium framing a single step back, the hero still large in the near ground and the hives crowding just behind it.
Medium framing from just inside the hedge line, the nearest two hives large and close at hand.
Medium framing across the little room, the nearest bench and its loaded surface close and large, the shelves just behind.
Medium framing with a hive stand close on the left and the flowering bank pressing in close on the right.
Medium framing a pace inside the shelter's open front, everything close under its own roof.
Low at landing-board height, the hive front rising large and close, the grass soft in the near foreground.
Low in the grass right beside the hive stand, looking along the entrances from a few inches off the ground.
Low and close, tilted up so the hive roof cuts across the upper frame and the hedge closes the background.
Low at bench height, the near edge and the nearest jars large across the bottom of the frame.
Low at ground level a hand's reach from the hero, the ground running away beneath it and the hive soft close behind.
Framed past a fan of hedge leaves at the very front of the shot, the hero sharp just beyond them.
Framed past a soft blurred timber edge in the near foreground, the hero sharp a single step behind it.
Framed from just inside the open half-door, the bench and its jars sharp close at hand.
Framed past a stand of flowering stems leaning across the near foreground, the hero sharp immediately behind.
Framed over a blurred lid in the near foreground, the hero standing clear and sharp close behind it.
